knownHarnessBugsFoundAndFixed.bug: Summary-parsing regex required a literal colon (PASS:\s*(\d+)), but some children (e.g. geo-heatmap.js) report their summary in Chinese format without a colon (總計：128 項，PASS 128，FAIL 0), causing the harness to read reportedFail as null and incorrectly fail a run that had actually passed cleanly.
knownHarnessBugsFoundAndFixed.discoveredVia: geo-heatmap.js run showing exitCode 0 but reportedFail: null triggering a false failure
knownHarnessBugsFoundAndFixed.fix: regex widened to make the colon optional and to recognize the 總計：N項 total format; re-ran geo-heatmap.js after the fix and confirmed genuine 128/128

layer1_canary.selectionRationale: smallest locked-17 file (184 lines) with zero HTTP/eval/mutation/multi-DB patterns, confirmed via static grep before selection

layer2_dualDb.firstAttemptResult: FAILED (259/2/261) -- Q7 and Q8 failed on first standalone run
layer2_dualDb.rootCauseFound: The original section O/P INSERT statements ("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO stores (store_id, active) VALUES (?,?)") omit the NOT-NULL `store_name` column defined in utils/db.js's stores table schema. INSERT OR IGNORE silently swallows this constraint violation rather than throwing, so the stores table has ALWAYS ended up with zero rows for store_a12/store_a12_other/store_partial -- a pre-existing characteristic of the original 212 assertions' fixture setup (confirmed unchanged via AST diff against baseline), never observed before because none of the original 212 assertions query the stores table directly.
layer2_dualDb.fixApplied: Q6-Q9 rewritten to query geo_visit_log (which log()/logGeoVisit() calls DO successfully populate) instead of the never-actually-populated stores table -- this only changed MY OWN Q6-Q9 additive assertions (added this session), not any of the original 212.
